why: every learned controller in this project has its worst per-leg slip ratio on RH (right hind): 1.41 in the best scheme-A runs, 11.08 in the frozen steady window, 1.139 in the frozen ANN verifier. If the cause is structural (geometry, ranges, contact), no amount of reward or training will fix it.
scope: static and kinematic diagnosis only: no control training, no gate change, no body modification
checks: per-leg joint ranges and key-frame angles, RH against its left counterpart LH
lowest material point height and the contacting geom per leg in the frozen key-frame pose
tarsus mesh frame orientation per leg (normal flip / mirrored assembly)
per-leg foot load share in a 1 s static hold with the frozen actuator holding the key frame
per-leg slip ratio and stance share from the best existing evaluation traces
success_definition: a concrete, checkable statement of whether RH differs structurally from the other legs, with numbers; no claim beyond what is measured
accounting: physics steps counted; a static hold is the only stepping done
